heuristics.name: classic-gloss
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is the standard plain gloss of a frequent ISEE Upper headword (e.g. frugal->thrifty, terse->brief)

heuristics.name: rarer-sense
heuristics.description: Prefer an option used in a less common sense typical of test vocabulary (foil = thwart)

heuristics.name: pos-majority
heuristics.description: Headword POS inferred from option parts of speech; pick among matching POS

notes: Options in this set are all plain glosses, so the classic-gloss heuristic is weak: most options in an item are themselves glosses of plausible headwords. Signal picks are where one option matched a very common ISEE headword gloss more strongly than the others. No option could be ruled out with certainty without the headword, so reject_certain is false throughout.
